liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Particular shoutout given to this song for being awesome [31]

## The recordings

- **gd1986-12-15.140293.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): source not stated; 25 songs; 175 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1986-12-15.nak300.damico.88884.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 171 min; rated 2.25/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd1986-12-15.128689.mtx.nicksmix.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 170 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1986-12-15.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.99035.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 169 min; rated 3.25/5 by 8 [5]
- **gd86-12-15.nakcm101-dwonk.25263.sbeok.flacf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 160 min; rated 4.48/5 by 23 [15]. Said about its sound: Band sounds a little rusty, but energy in Coliseum overshadows it [25]

## Around the show

- Fifteen thousand people grinning through tears of joy during the opening song [20]
- Band returned after six months off due to Garcia's diabetic coma [21]
- No dry eyes in the house when the band opened with the song [22]
- The song had the same emotional effect on the crowd as the opener [22]
- The place went absolutely crazy when the band broke out the song [24]
- Bill Graham sat beside the reviewer and Dave, exhausted, for fifteen minutes [26]
- Jerry pointed down at the crowd while singing the lyrics [28]
- Huge crowd response when Jerry announces the Candyman is back in town [29]
- Audience recording surpasses the SBD in capturing the crowd energy [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1986-12-15.140293.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: (FOB) Schoeps CMC4/MK41 > Oade M118 > Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM (unknown deck/hardware/software) > hard disk > Adobe Audition… [1]. Also: Nakamichi CM304 source supplies patches in Iko Iko and Wharf Rat [1]
- **gd1986-12-15.nak300.damico.88884.flac16**: taped by Joe D'Amico; source: nak 300 mics w/cp4 shotguns > sony d-5 > mac [2]. Also: Discs left as taped; disc two ends with drums, disc three continues [2]
- **gd1986-12-15.128689.mtx.nicksmix.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Nick Crump; source: 2 source matrix mix of AUD: shnid 80809 and SBD: shnid 99035 [3]. Also: Audience source has brief cut during Drums, left unpatched [3]
- **gd1986-12-15.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.99035.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walkerand Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/TDK MX-XG90/Dolby B) [5]
- **gd86-12-15.nakcm101-dwonk.25263.sbeok.flacf**: taped by Adam Smith & Andy Liu; transferred by Adam Smith & Andy Liu; source: Audience [15]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Wolfgang's: [Grateful Dead Laminate from Oakland Coliseum Arena, Dec 15, 1986 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/backstage-passes/grateful-dead/laminate/OCA861215.html) [33]
- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1986-12-15 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1986-12-15-oakland-alameda-county-coliseum-oakland-ca-usa/) [34]
- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1986-12-15 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1986-12-15-oakland-alameda-county-coliseum-oakland-ca-usa/) [35]
